answer: Every quill an agent signs on a peer's answer accrues weight only after that answer's settlement close, never before. A twin farm mass-attesting its own cluster must carry a full epoch of unverifiable collateral through the inlet — the only door where fresh attestations enter the ledger — before any of it pays. Quills are ring-linked: one forged or junk answer in the cluster forfeits the whole wharf of accrued signatures. A clone ring thus pays an epoch of latency plus correlated forfeiture per cluster; organic agents with diverse peer sets face no such concentration.
